subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 11: Get ready for… (exam practice)
outcomes: I can listen to the whole dialogue before I choose an answer.
I can write the correct word for a definition and spell it well.
I can ask and answer questions about choosing a smartphone.

tf.s: In a listening test, you should listen to the whole dialogue before you choose.
tf.why: The answer can come anywhere in the dialogue.

tf.s: The first picture you hear about is always the correct answer.
tf.why: The correct answer isn’t always at the beginning or the end.

tf.s: A café is a place where a waiter brings your food.
tf.why: Yes, you can eat and drink in a café.

tf.s: A printer is a small computer you can carry in a bag.
tf.why: That is a laptop; a printer prints on paper.

tf.s: Snorkelling is a sport you do outdoors, under the water.
tf.why: You swim and look under the water.

tf.s: A theatre is a place where actors work.
tf.why: Actors perform plays in a theatre.
The correct spelling is password, with double s.

tf.s: Spelling does not matter when you write words in the test.
tf.why: Always check your spelling; it is part of the answer.

tf.s: “Which girl?” “The one wearing headphones.” is a correct answer.
tf.why: The one wearing … tells us which person.

tf.s: Volleyball is a place where you watch films.
tf.why: Volleyball is a sport you play with a ball and a net.

boxes.q: Write the word: a small computer you can carry in a bag.
boxes.why: A laptop is small enough to carry.

boxes.q: Write the word: a place where actors work.
Complete: Which girl? – The one ___ headphones.
boxes.why: The one wearing … describes the person.

boxes.q: Which machine puts words and pictures on paper?
What should you do the first time you listen?
o: Listen carefully to the whole description.
Write the first word you hear.
boxes.why: Wait for the full description before you answer.

boxes.q: Which is a good question in a phone shop?
boxes.why: You ask about the price before you buy.

boxes.q: Which is a sport you play with a small ball, bats and a table?
boxes.why: Table tennis is played on a table.

boxes.q: Which part of a phone shows pictures and words?

hunt.q: A small computer you can carry
Where a waiter brings your food
Sport with a ball and a high net
Part of a tablet you look at

mcq.q: Why shouldn’t you choose the first thing you hear?
o: The correct answer isn’t always at the beginning or the end.
The first thing is always wrong.
mcq.why: Listen to the whole dialogue before you choose.

mcq.q: What should you check when you write words in Reading and Writing Part 1?
Which of these words is a place?
mcq.why: A café is a place where you eat and drink.

mcq.q: Which of these words is a device?
mcq.why: A laptop is a computer device.

mcq.q: “Which smartphone do you want to buy?” Choose the best answer.
o: The black one, because it has a bigger screen.
mcq.why: It answers which one and gives a reason.

mcq.q: You want to know about a smartphone’s camera. What do you ask?
mcq.why: A question about photos is about the camera.

mcq.q: Definition: “You can watch a play here.” Which word is correct?
mcq.why: Plays happen in a theatre, where actors work.

mcq.q: A boy says: “I wanted the blue phone… but no, I bought the red one.” Which phone did he buy?
mcq.why: He mentions blue first, but the answer comes later: red.

mcq.q: In a Listen and colour task, why wait for the full description?
o: You need to know exactly which thing to colour.
Because the colours are always the same.
So you can finish before the audio starts.
Because you only colour one thing.
mcq.why: The description tells you which object and which colour.

o: A sport you do outdoors, under the water
A game you play on a table
A sport with a big ball and a net
A place where you watch films
mcq.why: Snorkelling means swimming and looking under the water.
